name: Uwasa no Gokuhi Report ga Ryuushutsu!!? Joseito Iki Jigoku Kenkyuu Report

source:
A game-style report on the research findings of a certain school, all secrets revealed.

Subject A: Aki Kae
Participated in the research because her mother is on PTA board.
Strong-willed and vocal about her complaints as well as her desires.
We studied the process of bringing her down a notch.
See results: Suction, Hypnosis, Misery, Penetration

Subject B: Yuzu Miyauchi
Participated in the research to help further the field of medicine (her father has an illness with no cure).
Shy and withdrawn. We studied the process of perverting her.
See results: Penetration, Suction, Misery, Other Observations

Combined Subjects A, B
Simultaneous deflowering of the hymen using commonly available school objects.

Other results are documented.

对象A：阿树香。
因为母亲是PTA理事，她参加了这项研究。她性格强势，常直截了当地表达不满与欲望。研究内容是让她收敛锋芒的过程。
结果：吸乳、催眠、痛苦、插入。

对象B：宫内柚。
为了推进医学研究，她参加了这项研究（她的父亲患有无法治愈的疾病）。她性格害羞内向，研究内容是让她堕落的过程。
结果：插入、吸乳、痛苦、其他观察。

对象A与B：
使用学校里随处可得的物品，同时破坏两人的处女膜。

其他结果另有记录。
